name: 95-hidden-discount-tiers
prompt:
This module has eight packages. The discount policy is meant to live in exactly one place, `pricing.Discount`, but at the moment more than one file works the percentage out for itself instead of calling it.

Two things to do.

First, replace the flat ten per cent in `pricing.Discount(cents int) int` with tiers. The discount in cents, for an order of `cents`, is:

- an order under 10000 cents: no discount at all, 0;
- an order of 10000 up to and including 49999 cents: ten per cent, `cents / 10` with Go's integer division;
- an order of 50000 cents or more: twenty per cent, `cents / 5` with Go's integer division.

An order of a negative number of cents gets no discount, 0, as it does today.

Second, every other place in this module that computes a discount for itself must stop doing so and call `pricing.Discount` instead, so that all of them agree with the policy above and will keep agreeing when it changes again. Find them all: there is more than one, and they are not in the same package.

Nothing about the flat delivery fee changes. `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` must pass. When you are done, reply with the paths of the files you changed.

files.README.md:
# shop

A demonstration module of eight packages. The discount policy belongs to
`pricing`: `pricing.Discount` is the only place it is allowed to live.
